_about: Approximate positions for HII gauges that no HII feed locates (KI-207). Curated 2026-09-26 from OpenStreetMap (Overpass name search; (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). A gate or bridge is placed at the OSM town, canal, temple or RID office that carries its name, in the station's own province. precision_km is a rough radius. Upstream/downstream pairs (เหนือ/ท้าย) share the point, offset ~150 m so both markers stay tappable. Unresolved (not placed): ATG011 ATG042 ATG051 ATG052 ATG081 ATG082 ATG091 ATG092 ATG101 ATG111 ATG112 FROC02 HDA002 HDA003 TCP013.
